sloka: नहि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नासुरेषु सुरेषु वा ।यस्तस्य क्षिपतो बाणान् स्थातुमुत्सहतो ऽग्रतः ।। ५.३९.१५।।।।
transliteration: nahi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāsureṣu sureṣu vā ।yastasya kṣipato bāṇān sthātumutsahato 'grataḥ ।। 5.39.15।।।।

translations.english: "I do not see any one among humans or demons or even among gods who can face his arrows when released.
